raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and marking requirements for civilian firearms and ammunition exports. Exporters should re-verify ECCN classification (EAR Category 0 firearms and related items), confirm whether items now fall under EAR99 or a relaxed license exception, and update internal compliance programs accordingly. US HTS alignment, Section 301 tariff exposure, and BIS Entity List screening remain mandatory. Retain end-use/end-user statements and re-screen all consignees, since the rescission does not remove restrictions on exports to embargoed destinations or restricted parties.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的民用枪械出口规则，放宽了民用枪械及弹药出口的许可与标识要求。出口商应重新核实ECCN分类（EAR第0类枪械及相关物项），确认相关物项是否已归入EAR99或适用放宽的许可例外，并相应更新内部合规程序。美国HTS归类、301关税风险及BIS实体清单筛查仍为强制要求。应保留最终用途/最终用户声明并重新筛查所有收货人，因为该撤销并未解除对禁运目的地或受限实体的出口限制。

checklist.desc: Re-verify ECCN or EAR99 status for each firearm, ammunition, and component line after the rule rescission; document classification rationale and retain technical specs.
Check whether the rescinded rule's relaxed license exception applies to your destination and item; confirm no embargoed-country or restricted-party bar remains.
Map each item to the 10-digit HTS line, check Section 301 additional duty exposure, and document country of origin and value build-up.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List & restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Run restricted party and end-user screening for all consignees; retain end-use/end-user statements and screening records for audit.
Revise internal compliance program, license applications, and shipping documents to reflect the rescinded rule; train staff on new marking and recordkeeping requirements.
